study_context: Regional/ethnic distribution study comparing elite Kenyan runners against controls, used here to validate this project's medalist_origins.csv against independently published findings rather than assumption.
sample: 404 elite Kenyan runners (800m-marathon) and 87 Kenyan controls
source_note: Cited from a nutrition/performance study conducted at Iten training camp, Elgeyo Marakwet County (altitude 2400m, camp population ~1500 runners); original distribution figures as reported in that published research.
usage: notebooks/05_talent_geography_validation.py cross-references this project's own medalist_origins.csv (birthplace -> county) against these published proportions, reporting agreement/divergence rather than asserting a genetic or ethnic claim independently.
caveat: This is descriptive geographic/socioeconomic correlation from a single published study, not a claim about innate ability. Present alongside the grassroots-access and altitude-training-infrastructure explanations used in that same literature.
